title: Matching de catálogo
brief: Redesign of the proceso comercial matching screen (renglones of a licitación/directa vs the catalog), prioritizing the speed of resolving every renglón: confirm a candidato, search the catalog, mark sin match, re-choose resolved ones.

artboards.title: Cola con teclado
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest one-by-one: keyboard-only (Enter, 1-5, Shift alone for sin match, letters go to the search, Tab back, Ctrl+Z) with auto-advance and the whole queue visible; less useful for accepting many good suggestions at once

artboards.title: Planilla con aceptación masiva
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest for bulk: every renglón in one dense table with its top candidato inline and a confidence threshold to confirm many in one click; risk of accepting wrong matches without looking, little room to compare candidatos

artboards.title: Foco con comparación
artboards.tradeoff: Most accurate decisions: one renglón at a time with matching words and differing numbers highlighted, plus a color map to jump; slower overview and no bulk actions
